68 physical native MPN/manufacturer fields fixed in schematics and PCBs; two additional Harwin sockets and one loose shunt specified. component_selection.json and validation report are authoritative.

Manufacturer lands for R13/LEDs, socket drilling, Phoenix terminal dimensions; ERC/DRC/parity, actual drills/profile/paste, BOM/CPL and mechanical paths. Final evidence is source-bound; see preparation_checks.json.
USB service only with all external sources off, J1/J6/J7 unplugged, JP1 removed. Powered USB serial is not a qualified feature of this prototype release and is tested after receipt.
Confirm exact part sourcing/stock, including C10/R13/Harwin, MSL lot handling and no unapproved substitutions. Public catalogue identities do not reserve stock.
Approve actual panel/tab/tooling plan, finished holes including1.05mm sockets, ENIG and copper/thickness options, depanelized clip edges, THT process, and measured LM2596 peak<=245C.
Approve actual library rotations/pad1/polarities against supplied drawing and pad map. Native CPL angles are not assembler-library approval.
Obtain itemized quote for5A+5B assembled prototypes, electrical test options, lead time and delivery. Purchase/order authorization is separate from autonomous technical preparation.

after_prototype_before_operating_heater.action: Migrate PWM GPIO5 to25, handle ENABLE, ADS1115 address0x49, NTC calibration and safe behavior at boot/lost or invalid measurement. Verify real output off on faults.
Execute electronics_bench_plan.md: limited-current bring-up, startup/load/wifi, thermal, PWM/NTC noise, wiring and fault tests.
Define application-dependent independent overtemperature protection and its wiring. No independent thermal cutoff is present on current PCB.
Print clip/rail coupon; check actual DevKit/socket/LCD stack, USB fit, connector grip and fully wired board removal. Verify enclosure temperatures.
Check all intended modules against socket contacts and documented stack allowance, actual USB position and panel cable; do not infer universal body fit from equal header pitch.
Measure VIN/VBUS topology and qualify a VBUS-separated data arrangement before powered USB monitoring. No firmware replacement is needed for this power-path measurement.

future_variants.action: Review complete B protection/current/load and additional line/load conditions; do not carry 100 W rating over to 12 V.
Design protected low-drop 5 V distribution or other converter appropriate to source range. Current LM2596 input is not a 5 V pass-through.
